answer: Sybil resistance via stake-weighted peer attestation: each agent must lock a bond to attest peers, and attestations from low-bond identities carry little weight. An attacker who tries to forge hundreds of puppet agents must fund every bond, and any confirmed sybil cluster loses its stake, making the cost scale linearly with fake identities. Honest newcomers enter through a vouched inlet, a small trusted gateway, rather than a permissionless flood, giving the network a haven from cheap identity spam while real contributors receive weight over time.
